DefiLlama pool map is corroborating discovery, not claimed primary address publication. Dynamic primary readProxy market output was not fetched; no invented primary literal binding.

All four selected root methods delegate only fixed signatures to configured handler. Sender is preserved; deposit/repay pull msg.sender tokens, deposit credits own internal collateral ledger, repay reduces own debt, withdraw/borrow pay only msg.sender and cannot choose another payer/recipient. Existing token allowance, registered markets, risk rules and ordinary collateral prerequisites remain required. No approvals, crosschain messages, opaque handler/SI proxy bytes, flashloan, liquidator/role/admin calls or new signing capability admitted.

Inputs are handler unified accounting units, not raw6-decimal USDC. Proxy initializes unifiedTokenDecimal to10^18, and current implementation converts by floor(amount * underlyingTokenDecimal / unifiedTokenDecimal), with mutable configured scaling. Current scaling was not read through the unadmitted opaque handler proxy; callers must not infer current scaling from the token decimals alone. Transfers check exact sender/recipient balance delta. No minimum-received, deadline or slippage bound is provided.

flag=true requests market-manager interest/reward updates across relevant handlers; false uses in-action reward update and local accrual for deposit/repay, while withdraw/borrow invoke manager collateral/interest processing regardless. This boolean is bounded financial accounting, not a signature, delegation grant or executable payload. Mutable interest-model deltas may be positive or negative; no principal protection or fixed yield is asserted.

Withdraw silently clips request to own accrued deposit, collateralizable amount and handler available accounting liquidity; borrow clips to own available credit and handler liquidity-ratio limit. Both then require price-valued adjusted amount <= mutable action limit; zero output is possible if limits are zero. Repay clips amount to own accrued debt. Effects update internal storage then transfer and revert atomically on failure. Source does not guarantee requested amount, perpetual availability or non-lossy collateral; borrow creates liquidatable debt.

Proxy boolean return only reports delegatecall success, not output amount; wrapper does not decode underlying handler return. Selected calls have no exit queue or claim surface. Data storage, manager, interest model, oracle, reward storage, current balances/limits and circuit states were not independently runtime-attested. Payable deposit/repay expressly require msg.value0 for this ERC20 handler.
